description: Return whether the element identified by ref or selector is present in the DOM. A no-match is a normal result (exists: false), NOT an error — so an agent can poll for appearance/disappearance. Returns: { ok, session_id, exists }. Errors: TRANSPORT_UNSUPPORTED, NOT_RUNNING, BAD_ARGUMENT (invalid selector or ref+selector both/neither).

ref.description: Element ref from a snapshot (resolves to [data-sw-ref="N"]). Provide ref OR selector.

selector.description: CSS selector. Provide ref OR selector, not both.

sessionId.description: Target session id. Omit when a single session is running.

name: electron_exists
title: Check whether an element exists
